bulletin5.advisory_ne: कात्तिक २९ देखि मंसिर ३ सम्म पाँचै दिन देशभर कुनै मौसम चेतावनी छैन; बिहानको बुलेटिनमा आजका लागि रहेको पहेँलो साँझको बुलेटिनमा हटाइएको छ। तराई, उपत्यका र खोँचमा बिहानपख हुस्सु/कुहिरो।

bulletin5.map_note_en: DHM's 5-day warning maps are green (no warning) across the country on all five days, Kartik 29 to Mangsir 3.

country.analysis_ne: हाल नेपालमा पश्चिमी न्युनचापीय प्रणालीको आंशिक प्रभाव रहेको छ ।
country.analysis_en: The country is currently under the partial influence of a western low-pressure system.
country.day_ne: देशको हिमाली भू-भागमा साधारणतया बादल लाग्नेछ । कोशी प्रदेश लगायत देशका पहाडी भू-भागमा आंशिक बादल लाग्नेछ । तराई भू-भाग, उपत्यका तथा खोँचहरूमा बिहानपख थोरै स्थानमा हुस्सु/कुहिरो लाग्नेछ । देशका हिमाली भू-भाग तथा कोशी र गण्डकी प्रदेशको पहाडी भू-भागको एक-दुई स्थानमा हल्का वर्षा/हिमपातको सम्भावना छ।
country.day_en: Generally cloudy conditions will prevail over the Himalayan region of the country, while partly cloudy conditions will prevail over the Hilly regions of the country, including Koshi Province. Fog/mist is likely at a few places over the Terai region, valleys, and river basins during the early morning. There is a possibility of light rain/snowfall at one or two places in the Himalayan region of the country, as well as in the Hilly regions of Koshi and Gandaki Provinces.
country.night_ne: कोशी प्रदेश लगायत बागमती र गण्डकी प्रदेशको हिमाली र पहाडी भू-भागमा आंशिक बादल लाग्नेछ तथा बाँकी भू-भागमा मौसम मूख्यतया सफा रहनेछ। कोशी प्रदेशको हिमाली र पहाडी भू-भाग तथा गण्डकी प्रदेशको हिमाली भू-भागको एक-दुई स्थानमा हल्का वर्षा/हिमपातको सम्भावना छ।
country.night_en: Partly cloudy conditions will prevail over the Himalayan and Hilly regions of Koshi, Bagmati, and Gandaki Provinces, while the weather will remain mainly fair over the rest of the country. There is a possibility of light rain/snowfall at one or two places in the Himalayan and Hilly regions of Koshi Province, as well as in the Himalayan region of Gandaki Province.
